features.title: What the maker does
features.lead: Everything a custom football shirt creator should do, in the browser, without a designer on your side.
items: Real-time 3D
Rotate the shirt as you build it. What you see is the sublimation file we print — no surprises at the mockup stage.
Colours without limits
Every panel, trim and stripe takes any colour. Gradients, patterns and fades cost nothing extra — it's all one print.
Crest & sponsor upload
Upload your club crest and sponsor logos in the tool. A designer cleans and print-preps every logo before production.
Names & numbers
Add the full roster with per-player names, numbers and sizes on the cart. Included in the price.
Finished templates
Every template opens as a finished design in an intentional colorway — start from something good, not a blank shape.
Order from the tool
No quote, no email chain. Set quantities, check the price ladder and check out. A production mockup follows in 24–48 h.

synonyms.title: Maker, creator, designer, kit builder — one tool
synonyms.body: Teams search for a football shirt maker, a football kit designer, a jersey creator or a kit builder. They mean the same thing: a tool that turns an idea into a real, wearable football jersey. MOMUTO's version is the 3D designer — free to use, real-time, and wired straight to production, so the design you approve is the design that ships. If you would rather not build it yourself, the same team that runs the tool will design it for you: first mockup in 24–48 hours.

faq.title: Football jersey maker FAQ
items: Is the football jersey maker really free?
Yes. Designing in the 3D tool is free and needs no account. You pay only when you place an order, and the price is the ladder above — no setup, art or screen fees.
Can I make a single football shirt?
Yes. There is no minimum order. A single jersey is €38.90; the per-jersey price falls to €21.90 at 10 and €16.90 at 100.
Can I upload my own crest and sponsor?
Yes. Upload PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF artwork in the maker. A designer cleans every crest and sponsor before production and sends you the file for approval.
Does the maker handle names and numbers?
Yes. Add the squad on the cart with each player's name, number and size. Names and numbers are included in the price; long sleeves are +€3 per player.
What if I don't like the result?
You approve a production mockup before anything prints, with unlimited revisions. If a shirt arrives defective or different from the approved mockup, we reprint or refund it — see the returns policy.
Can I use an AI-generated kit design?
Yes. Send a ChatGPT, Midjourney or Gemini concept through the AI concept page and a designer rebuilds it as a print-ready football jersey.
How long does a custom football kit take?
Mockup in 24–48 hours, 7–12 days production, 10–15 days shipping: plan on 25–30 days door to door. The fast lane (+€59) saves about a week.
